summary: Re-ran backend pytest suite and all 12 persisted browser checks from iteration 1 (by name only, no script changes). All checks passed. Transient python http.server used by static-lane checks (port 4173) had to be restarted since it is not supervisor-managed and did not survive the session gap; this is an environment/process-lifecycle detail, not an application bug, and was restarted before rerunning the static checks.
action_items: The static SPA checks depend on a manually-started `python3 -m http.server 4173` serving /app/frontend/dist. It is not supervisor-managed and will not survive pod restarts/session gaps. If a future agent sees ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on localhost:4173 for the static-* checks, restart it (cd /app/frontend/dist && nohup python3 -m http.server 4173 &) before re-running - not an app bug.
